WHAT HAPPENS NEXT

You'll see the information Nairobi West Clinic has chosen to share with you. If something looks wrong or is missing, contact Nairobi West Clinic directly.

The password link works once. If it has already been used, or you lose this email, choose "Forgot password" on the sign-in page and Afiax will send you a new link.
